content: When responding to UDS Service 0x19 with subfunction 0x05 and DTCStoredDataRecordNumber is 0x00, the Dcm module shall obtain the status of the DTC by first calling Dem_SelectDTC() with the following parameters: • ClientId: Client Id for this Dcm instance (see DcmDemClientRef ) • DTC: DTC as defined in [SWS_Dcm_00388] • DTCOrigin: DEM_DTC_ORIGIN_PRIMARY_MEMORY and then Dem_GetStatusOfDTC() with the following parameter: • ClientId: Client Id for this Dcm instance (see DcmDemClientRef )
